notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Release
notes.notes:
Patch notes for version 1.2.1
[list]
[*] Increased initial window size.
[*] Reduced blurriness on HotHead.
[*] Shield power up will now protect you from Stampers.
[*] Re-organized the Options menu.
[*] Added a list of the controls in the options menu.
[*] Added the ability to modify the volume of the music and sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Release - New Control Scheme
notes.notes: A new update is available for HotHead. In the options settings you can now select "Keyboard & Mouse B" to use the "Space Bar" for jump and "Tab" key to pause.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Release - Achievements Added
notes.notes:
An update for HotHead is now available. 18 achievements have been added to the game.

If you have previously played the game and already accomplished what you need for an achievement then the achievement will be awarded to you as soon as you start the game.
